changelog:
**Major update—Context Mode skill reimagined for coding session resilience:**

- Complete rewrite of the skill to target Claude Code session longevity, focusing on output filtering, session logging, and auto-resume.
- Added robust output filtering to strip verbose or redundant command output, keeping only errors and critical summary lines in context.
- Introduced an automated session log (session.log) that tracks files edited, commands run, tasks in progress, and the last user prompt and action.
- On reset, skill now resumes from the session log—restoring state, listing pending tasks, and continuing work without user re-instruction.
- New activation and output messages for clarity and consistent communication of session status.
- Provided ready-to-copy CLAUDE.md installation snippet to make Context Mode permanent for any project.
- Removed old documentation (skill-card.md); SKILL.md now fully documents usage, behavior, and installation.
summary: Keep Claude Code sessions productive across resets with output filtering, session logging, and auto-resume. Use when starting a long or complex coding sessio...
